description: THE HASH-COMMITTED ASSESSMENT OF A VAULT, in the shape ERC-8004’s Reputation Registry points at, and the only thing here a third party can publish on chain under their own name. Until 2026-10-21 this document was reachable from the API and the web and from NO tool, so an agent could read every figure behind it and not the document itself. Each dimension is its own score and they are never blended: a vault can have an excellent record and a poor provenance grade, and one number would destroy the distinction this platform exists to draw. `data.document` is what the hash covers, byte for byte, and `data.feedbackHash` is that hash. READ `data.document.refusals` BEFORE ANY MISSING DIMENSION: from aspern-0.4 an absent dimension is UNREAD unless a refusal names it, and a refusal means we hold a reading we will not stand behind — a liquidity share over 100% of the vault, for instance, which is a disagreement between two of our own readings rather than a fact about the vault. `data.alsoPublished` sits deliberately OUTSIDE the hash: the risk band, the lending figures and the books reconciliation are ASPERN’s own reading, and a consumer attesting the hash is attesting the document alone. `data.erc8004` carries the call arguments for whoever wants to publish it; ASPERN does not make those calls and never holds a mainnet key. Ask for an older `methodology` to rebuild a document at the version a hash was issued under; the list is on /v1/meta. Free.

methodology.description: Build the document at an older methodology version, so a hash issued under it stays checkable. Omit for the current one. THIS IS THE DOCUMENT’S OWN VERSION and not `meta.methodologyVersion`, which stamps every answer this API serves and moves for different reasons; the two were one number until 2026-10-21 and will drift apart.

slug.description: The vault’s slug, or its contract address — either resolves.

name: vault_assessment

availability.description: Whether a document could be built at all, and when it was read. An assessment rests on a record: where there is not enough of one, `status` says so and `data` is absent, which is a fact about OUR evidence for this vault and not a judgement of the vault.

data.description: The document and everything published beside it: `document` (what the hash covers, with `assessments`, `observations`, `refusals` and `limitations`), `feedbackHash`, `alsoPublished` (our own risk band, lending figures and books reconciliation, deliberately OUTSIDE the hash) and `erc8004` (the call arguments, one giveFeedback per dimension). Null where no document could be built.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

metric.description: Always `assessment` here. The route answers in the availability envelope every per-vault reading uses.

slug.description: The vault this document is for, read back so an answer cannot be attached to the wrong vault.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
